verdict.rationale: GitHub Copilot is itself a coding agent, so it fills the MCP client role, and serving tools to other agents is a different product role. The MCP evidence is all client-side: connecting MCP servers to Copilot Chat, admin allow lists, and using the GitHub MCP server from within Copilot Chat. None of it shows Copilot itself running as an MCP server, so this axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
